summary: Polibeli Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a non-binding MOU with AUTHAIKAM COMPANY LIMITED for preliminary evaluation of a potential AI computing center in Thailand. The MOU contemplates up to 100 MW power capacity but involves no committed investment, definitive agreements, or deal terms. No price, stake, premium, or board recommendation is provided; the filing is a routine disclosure of a non-binding exploratory arrangement. This is not a special situation but a preliminary evaluation with no binding obligation. Watch for any subsequent definitive agreements or termination of discussions.
